L194: Starting today, the cite57†Claude Marketplace brings plugins and connectors, agents and products, and service partners into one place. For customers, it provides a single destination to find the right tools and services. For builders and partners, it offers an easier way to reach teams using Claude.
L195: ## For customers: discover tools and services to help you do more with Claude
L196: 
L197: The Claude Marketplace is where teams find what they need to expand how they use Claude. You can:
L198:   * Add connectors and plugins. Choose from more than 2,000 available today, including Atlassian, Google, Microsoft, Notion, Salesforce, and more.
L199:   * Buy agents and products. Use a portion of your committed Anthropic spend on Claude-powered software from companies like CrowdStrike, Cursor, Harvey, Legora, Lovable, and Snowflake.
L200:   * Scale with service partners. Connect with a consulting partner or system integrator from the cite58†Claude Partner Network†partnerhub.claude.com , such as Accenture, Boston Consulting Group, or Deloitte, to build your AI strategy and roll Claude out across your organization.
L201: cite59†Image†cdn.prod.website-files.com L202: ## For builders and partners: get discovered by teams using Claude
L203: 
L204: Companies that build tools, products, or services for Claude customers can be listed in the Claude Marketplace. Pick the path that fits what you offer:
L205:   * Building for teams that use Claude? Create a cite60†connector or cite61†plugin using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent Skills, the open standards pioneered by Anthropic.
L206:   * Selling a Claude-powered agent or product? cite62†Apply to list it on the marketplace. Teams can then use a portion of their committed Anthropic spend to buy it.
L207:   * Offering consulting or systems integration? Join the cite63†Claude Partner Network to appear in the marketplace, where Claude customers can find and connect with you.
L208: cite64†Image: Logo†cdn.prod.website-files.com cite64†Image: Logo†cdn.prod.website-files.com L209: 
L210: We want work to feel effortless for our mutual customers: ask Claude a question and trust that it truly understands your world. Atlassian’s Teamwork Graph brings the full context of Confluence, Jira, and other apps into Claude through our connector, so every response is grounded in what’s really going on across your teams and tools.
L211: 
L212: Jamil Valliani, Head of Product, AI, Atlassian
L213: cite65†Image: Logo†cdn.prod.website-files.com cite66†Image: Logo†cdn.prod.website-files.com L214: 
L215: AI is changing how enterprises operate – and how technology is procured, deployed, and run. Security is leading the charge. Together with Anthropic, we’re bringing the Falcon platform to the Claude Marketplace, putting AI-native cybersecurity where enterprises are putting AI to work. We’re turning frontier AI into a force multiplier for defenders
L216: 
L217: Daniel Bernard, Chief Business Officer, Crowdsrike

L231:
